notes.title: If you own the old TBH, you'll get TBHRE in your library for free!
notes.content: Once The Bathhouse Restored Edition officially releases on Steam, if you own the old TBH in your Steam library, you will receive the game in your Steam library for free!

notes.title: For those who own old version of The Bathhouse
notes.content:
Steam informed us that if you own The Bathhouse (Old) on Steam, you are able to play The Bathhouse RE for free.  
However, it is up to Steam to decide HOW or WHEN it will be offered to you. 
We will notify you as soon as Steam confirms more in detail.
